name: netbox
summary: [Netbox](https://github.com/netbox-community/netbox) is an IP address management (IPAM) and data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tool. Initially conceived by the network engineering team at DigitalOcean, NetBox was developed specifically to address the needs of network and infrastructure engineers. It is intended to function as a domain-specific source of truth for network operations.

ports.description: will map the container's port 8000 to port 8000 on the host

env.name: ALLOWED_HOST
env.description: The hostname you will use to access the app (e.g., netbox.example.com)

env.name: BASE_PATH
env.description: The path you will use to access the app (i.e., /netbox, default: none)

env.name: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
env.description: List of comma-separated, single quoted, trusted origins. Must include protocol, and port if applicable (default: [])

env.name: REMOTE_AUTH_BACKEND
env.description: Python path to the custom Django authentication backend to use for external user authentication (default: netbox.authentication.RemoteUserBackend)

env.name: REMOTE_AUTH_HEADER
env.description: Name of the HTTP header which informs NetBox of the currently authenticated user. (default: HTTP_REMOTE_USER)

env.name: REMOTE_AUTH_AUTO_CREATE_USER
env.description: If true, NetBox will automatically create local accounts for users authenticated via a remote service (default: False)

env.name: REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_GROUPS
env.description: The list of groups to assign a new user account when created using remote authentication (default: [])

env.name: REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS
env.description: A mapping of permissions to assign a new user account when created using remote authentication (default: {})

docs.setup:
Netbox requires a postgres database and a redis instance.

Access the WebUI at <your-ip>:8000. For more information, check out [NetBox](https://github.com/netbox-community/netbox).

changelog.text: Rebase to Alpine 3.23. Add CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS env settings. Drop support for environments with explicitly disabled IPv6.
Restructure init to allow for plugins as mods.
Add required packages for LDAP support.
Build local docs on first run.
Rebase to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.
Remove py3-pillow, add tiff to fix deps.
Add py3-pillow package back on arm to fix build issue.
Remove py3-pillow package to fix dependency issue with 3.2.0.
